independent_interpretation_recovery.ordered_allegiance: The decisive question is how genuine created benefits and duties can be acknowledged without treating power as the final good. Cyrus can liberate without being Christ or knowing God; render remains a real debt bounded by godliness; the divine image makes Gods claim whole-person rather than one competing compartment.
independent_interpretation_recovery.willing_service: The decisive question is how duties become sincere human service when the capacity and the will themselves depend on grace. Cyrus lacks recognition despite effectiveness; Thessalonian work manifests rather than buys election; divine action reaches willing and doing without cancelling freedom; ransom is received before imitation.
independent_interpretation_recovery.relationship: Complementary but distinct: the ordering of goods and obligations does not by itself convert the giver, while inward sincerity does not cancel debts. The comparison is interleaved across Cyrus, coin, Pauline action, light, shelter and both Communion options.
